title: Auctioneer
summary: AUCTIONEE'R, noun [Latin auctionarius.] The person who sells at auction; a person licensed by government to dispose of goods or lands by public sale to the highest bidder. AUCTIONEE'R, verb transitive

inlines.v: AUCTIONEE'R, noun [Latin auctionarius.] The person who sells at auction; a person licensed by government to dispose of goods or lands by public sale to the highest bidder. AUCTIONEE'R, verb transitive To sell at auction.
